title: Kir and compartment interaction investigation with measured-data checks
disposition_reason: The retained full30 route accepts structurally valid public-outcome reports without numerical grading; it can admit scientifically wrong values. The revised objective requires independent estimator and support recomputation before any investigation-correctness score.

scientific_target.question: How do prespecified relative-rank coactivity–plasticity associations differ across Kir/control and apical/basal groups after checking baseline overlap and mouse-level sensitivity?
scientific_target.known_answer: Prespecified Kir-by-neural-feature-by-compartment contrasts and cohort sensitivity estimates from measured records, plus valid null/unavailable/rank-deficient/zero-overlap dispositions. No nonzero Kir effect is assumed correct.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Author archive15047046 contains control and Kir spine measurements. Historical full30 declaration describes relative-rank weighted least squares, but the exact transformation/weight/contrast source and trusted reference values are absent here.
scientific_target.case_unit: One four-group public investigation: apical_control, apical_kir, basal_control, basal_kir, with all and balanced-support panels.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; historical declaration says20 control and10 Kir mice, not1936 independent spines.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Observational comparison of source-defined perturbation cohorts unless allocation and cohort equivalence are independently established. Kir is an experimental manipulation, but this archive does not by itself establish randomized comparable allocation for this estimator.
exclusions: No treatment causality from an unchecked cohort comparison.
No protected prediction: later outcomes are public inputs.
No numerical-correctness claim from report shape admission alone.

inputs: Measured baseline/followup morphology, neural features, Kir/control indicators, compartment and mouse/FOV/dendrite grouping for the full selected cohort.
All and prespecified balanced-support panels; retain units and acquisition/cohort metadata needed for sensitivity.
forbidden_inputs: Trusted expected report values or numerical answers from private grader.
Any post-hoc selection of a favorable treatment/compartment contrast or overlap subset.
observation_contract.case_identity: Historical full30 manifest declares44 source members,1936 input rows (1143 control,793 Kir),8 public export members and6 public view members. Actual opaque row/group identity export is absent; an eligible deletion roster may contain fewer than30 mice.
observation_contract.split: This is a public-outcome cohort investigation. Mouse-level deletion preserves all compartments and source-membership repeats; no held-out target split is delivered or claimed.
observation_contract.coverage: All declared30 input mice across four groups with separate all/balanced panels. Group membership totals and report terms are not new registrations or independent datasets.

primary.name: complete interaction-report numerical error
primary.aggregation: Report each prespecified relative-rank WLS interaction, group support and balanced-panel contrast against an independent recomputation, with native-unit tolerances frozen only after recovering original arithmetic.
primary.rationale: A structural JSON acceptance check cannot establish correct biological analysis; the revised primary measures the numerical estimands and support actually claimed.

secondary: Mouse-deletion stability and complete all-versus-balanced-support comparison.
Baseline-size/activity overlap, group acquisition sensitivity and rank/estimability diagnostics.
Prespecified three-way interaction with its lower-order terms, avoiding selective two-group comparisons.

comparators.name: Nuisance-only cohort model
comparators.inputs: Baseline morphology, movement activity, compartment and cohort acquisition variables.
comparators.procedure: Freeze a mouse-balanced procedure and examine overlap before estimating Kir-dependent neural effects.

comparators.name: Common coactivity association
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance inputs plus a common neural slope.
comparators.procedure: Compare against the interaction model on identical support; report both coefficient sets.

comparators.name: Kir/compartment interaction
comparators.inputs: Same inputs plus prespecified neural×Kir×compartment terms.
comparators.procedure: Reproduce the declared rank/WLS estimand only after exact weights/rank conventions are recovered; missing overlap yields unavailable, not a fabricated zero.

nuisance_controls: Do not assume treatment allocation was randomized or exchangeable between source cohorts.
Balance baseline size and activity only using prespecified rules; show retained and excluded support.
Preserve paired apical/basal observations of the same mouse and handle cohort/acquisition differences.
evaluation.uncertainty: At most30 input mice with uncertainty tied to the actual estimable mouse roster; use complete-mouse deletion/cluster methods, not1936 row-level replicates. If rank deficiency or zero overlap prevents an estimand, report that without forced pooling.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all report terms and support/dispositions; structural validity never substitutes for trusted numerical comparison. Preserve null, unavailable, rank-deficient and zero-overlap results. Do not silently discard failed contrasts.
